# IRoundsVaultBaseEvents
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/rounds-vault/IRoundsVaultBaseEvents.sol)

**Title:**
IRoundsVaultBaseEvents

**Author:**
Roberto Cano <robercano>

Events emitted by the `RoundsVaultBase` contract.


## Events
### RoundAdvanced
Emitted by `nextRound` after closing the current round and opening the next one.


```solidity
event RoundAdvanced(uint256 indexed roundId);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`roundId`|`uint256`|The id of the round that was just closed (moved from `Opened` to `InSettlement`)|

### WithdrawExchangeAsset
Emitted by `redeemExchangeAsset` when a single past-round receipt is burned and the
exchange asset is paid out.


```solidity
event WithdrawExchangeAsset(
    address indexed caller,
    address indexed receiver,
    address indexed owner,
    uint256 exchangeAssetAmount,
    uint256 receiptId,
    uint256 receiptAmount
);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`caller`|`address`|The address that invoked the redemption|
|`receiver`|`address`|The address that received the exchange asset|
|`owner`|`address`|The address whose receipts were burned|
|`exchangeAssetAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of exchange asset transferred to `receiver`|
|`receiptId`|`uint256`|The round id of the burned receipts|
|`receiptAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of receipts that were burned|

### WithdrawExchangeAssetBatch
Emitted by `redeemExchangeAssetBatch` when several past-round receipts are burned in
one call and the cumulative exchange asset is paid out.


```solidity
event WithdrawExchangeAssetBatch(
    address indexed caller,
    address indexed receiver,
    address indexed owner,
    uint256 exchangeAssetAmount,
    uint256[] receiptIds,
    uint256[] receiptAmounts
);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`caller`|`address`|The address that invoked the redemption|
|`receiver`|`address`|The address that received the exchange asset|
|`owner`|`address`|The address whose receipts were burned|
|`exchangeAssetAmount`|`uint256`|The total exchange asset transferred to `receiver`|
|`receiptIds`|`uint256[]`|The round ids of the burned receipts|
|`receiptAmounts`|`uint256[]`|The amount of receipts burned per round id (aligned with `receiptIds`)|

### RoundSettled
Emitted by `setRoundSettled` once the settlement trade has executed and the per-round
exchange rate has been snapshotted.


```solidity
event RoundSettled(uint256 indexed roundId, Price exchangeRate);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`roundId`|`uint256`|The round id that was settled|
|`exchangeRate`|`Price`|The snapshotted per-round exchange rate|

### MinPositionSizeUpdated
Emitted by `setMinPositionSize` when the governor updates the minimum aggregate
position size.


```solidity
event MinPositionSizeUpdated(uint256 oldMin, uint256 newMin);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`oldMin`|`uint256`|The previous minimum (in target-vault assets)|
|`newMin`|`uint256`|The new minimum (in target-vault assets); 0 disables the check|

### EmergencyRoundRolledBack
Emitted by `emergencyRollbackRound` when the governor moves a stuck `InSettlement`
round back to `Opened`.


```solidity
event EmergencyRoundRolledBack(uint256 indexed roundId);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`roundId`|`uint256`|The round id that was rolled back|

### RoundRetried
Emitted by `retryRound` when the keeper pushes a past `Opened` round back to
`InSettlement` for another settlement attempt.


```solidity
event RoundRetried(uint256 indexed roundId);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`roundId`|`uint256`|The round id that was retried|
